title: Main study: three-model games
description: 12 three-player games with claude-opus-5-5, gemini-3.8-flash and gpt-6.1-sol, all at medium effort. Cycle seating over seeds 8349–8360, no experiment profile. Judged on the whole game by gpt-6.1-sol; these annotations are the ones reported in the thesis. The Opus judge runs from 28 Oct are kept only as audit history.
